description: Return 30-day query volume for one or more deployments from the local registry. Official subgraph-MCP name; unlike official, these numbers are real (the official tool has been observed returning 0 for ENS, Lido, Uniswap). Pass ipfs_hashes (Qm…) and/or ids. Does not query the gateway. Unknown hashes return query_volume_30d: null with error not_in_registry rather than a fake 0.

ipfs_hashes.description: Manifest IPFS hashes (Qm…), the official subgraph-MCP input

name: get_deployment_30day_query_counts
